messages:
Maya: Quick q: how are we treating config-only changes for semver? e.g. default timeout change or a tweak to autoscale params — patch or minor? Also a proposal to add build metadata to tags (like +ci.12345) so CI artifacts map to git tags. Thoughts?

Sam: my take: patch for non-API behavior changes. Minor should be for any public API/behavior additions. But default changes that change user-visible behavior are fuzzy.

Jordan: agreed with Sam. Rule of thumb: if a user can observe different behavior without changing code (just upgrading) and it could require action -> minor. Small safe tweaks -> patch. Build metadata is fine for traceability, e.g. `v2.4.1+ci.9876`. It doesn’t affect precedence.

Nina: we should also ensure release notes gating. If a PR changes runtime defaults or throttling, require a `release-note/required` label and a short changelog entry. Patches should be allowed to auto-deploy only if they have no user-visible defaults change.

Maya: sounds reasonable. Proposal: update the checklist:
- auto-bump to patch for docs/tests/chore-only PRs
- PRs touching `public_api/` or `sdk/` -> require manual minor bump and a changelog entry
- any default/tuning changes -> `release-note/required` and reviewer ack

Sam: +1. Also suggest CI check: inspect changed paths and surface a warning that recommends bump level (but allow override with `semver: minor` in PR body).

Jordan: put this in the release-playbook. Quick example tag formats for clarity:
```
# canonical git tag
vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
# with pre-release for canary
v2.5.0-canary.3
# with build metadata for CI mapping
v2.5.0+ci.20260301
```
PRs should use `semver:` in the body to override CI suggestion when necessary.

Maya: also thinking about pinning dependencies in dedicated deployments. Should tags used for customer pinning include build metadata? I think no — keep customer-facing tags clean (no +meta) and use annotated release notes to link to CI build.

Nina: yes, customers should see stable `vX.Y.Z`. Internal images can include `:vX.Y.Z-ci.123` but the canonical git tag stays `vX.Y.Z`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: canary rollout started for `v2.4.3-canary.1` to cluster-alpha (20% traffic). See https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/2345

Sam: perfect timing to test this. If the canary touches defaults we force manual hold until release-note is written.

Maya: I'll draft a tiny RFC and update the release checklist + CI lint rule this afternoon. tagging script snippet I'll add to the RFC:
```
# create tag and push
git tag -a v2.5.0 -m "release v2.5.0"
git push origin v2.5.0
# for CI-mapped artifact
docker tag service:latest service:v2.5.0-ci.123
```

Jordan: thanks — sounds clear. If anyone wants to add edge cases (db migrations, feature flags) put them in the RFC comments.

Nina: noted. I'll add a quick test for the CI check to our `release-tests` job.

Maya: awesome, thanks all. I'll post the RFC link here once ready. :sparkles:
